articles.title: SpaceXSI defends Grok over sexualised AI images of UK lawmaker, says fake content cannot violate privacy
articles.description: Elon Musk’s SpaceX Super Intelligence has challenged a British lawmaker’s lawsuit over sexually explicit AI-generated images of her, arguing that content which is clearly fictitious cannot amount to an invasion of privacy. The case could set an important precedent for determining whether AI companies can be held responsible for content their platforms generate.
